base: Use case: photorealistic-natural. Asset type: architectural base plate for an interactive prayer-room website, 1536x1024 landscape 3:2. Create a quietly beautiful realistic small multi-faith prayer room, as carefully photographed by an architectural magazine. Perfectly straight level camera, one-point perspective, looking squarely at the rear wall; rear wall fills most frame. Warm ivory mineral plaster, warm grey woven carpet, subtle oak skirting and a restrained ceiling cove. On the LEFT 58% of the back wall is ONE BROAD FLOOR-TO-CEILING RECTANGULAR GLASS-WALL OPENING, from approximately x=110 to x=870 and y=170 to y=750 on this1536x1024 canvas. The rectangle must have perfectly horizontal top and bottom and vertical sides. Its entire interior is a uniform flat neutral medium-dark grey placeholder: NO scene, NO door leaf, NO vertical mullions, NO reflections, NO furniture inside opening. Only a very slim charcoal perimeter frame around this opening, naturally integrated in plaster; the website will insert transparent glazing and a destination view here. The solid prayer-facing plaster wall continues on the RIGHT from x=900 onward. In front of this solid right wall place ONE beautiful modest navy prayer mat, seen completely from head to foot, its long axis leading toward that EMPTY SOLID WALL, away from the glass opening. Mat has a fine ivory geometric border, no calligraphy or picture. The mat head is near base of solid wall at x=1180 y=760 and foot closer to camera at x=1250 y=960. There must be only bare wall in front of the mat; no window, door, altar, furniture, shoes or ornament in the prayer direction. Daylight is soft and diffuse from the opening on left, soft warm cove light, believable contact shadows, tactile natural materials, no dramatic beams. Simple humane welcoming room, precision and quiet rather than hotel opulence. No text, logos, people, signs, arched motifs, columns, floating objects, plants or decorative furniture. The full room is visible, no extreme wide angle or distorted geometry. Make the opening very wide, elegant and rectangular so it can become a transparent glass wall with a single glass door. Render as a realistic photograph, not a shiny 3D showroom.

Change ONLY the solid wall on the RIGHT directly beyond the head of the mat: add one shallow, elegant pointed-arch mihrab niche carved into the same ivory plaster, centered x=1180, spanning approximately x=1060 to1300, top y=340 and base y=785. It is a subtle architectural recess, not a doorway: solid closed plaster back, only10cm depth, no exit, no glass. Slim plain edge, softly shaded natural ivory, no gold trim, text, religious calligraphy, lamps, books, shelves, ornament or objects. The mat points directly to this quiet empty niche. Simple architectural prayer room influenced by a contemporary prayer corner under a glass skylight. Keep left aperture blank and absolutely unchanged because a live destination view is composited there later. Do not add any pattern or object elsewhere. Photorealistic, restrained, premium and welcoming.
